## Visualizing Heterozygosity and FST for Two Populations

Explore how genetic diversity and differentiation arise in populations!  
This interactive app lets you experiment with allele frequencies and see, in real time, how heterozygosity (H) and FST change as populations diverge or become more similar.  
By adjusting the sliders, you can discover the mathematical beauty behind population genetics and develop an intuition for how evolutionary forces shape genetic variation.  
Use this tool to test your predictions, visualize key concepts, and deepen your understanding of how genetic structure evolves.

[Open in a new tab](https://tahirali-biomics.shinyapps.io/het-fst-app/)
